"}, {"insert": "从核电站，跳到金融科技。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Braden Dennis就是这么干的。他以前是搞核能和水电的工程师。现在，他是Fiscal.ai的创始人，年入七位数，正向八位数冲刺。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Braden有个理想。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他想发明点对地球有益的新技术。这个理想，他到现在还没放弃。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他迷上了另一件事——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "投资。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始疯狂研究市场。读遍了巴菲特、芒格的股东信，看了所有能找到的访谈和书。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "越研究，他越发现一个奇怪的现象。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "金融市场两端极端分化。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一端是昂贵的专业数据终端，像Bloomberg，贵得离谱，普通人用不起。另一端是免费的炒股App，界面丑陋，广告满天飞，一点不专业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "中间空荡荡。什么都没有。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Braden懵了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""上市公司的财报都是公开的！为什么聚合这些数据、提供干净体验，会这么难？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现了机会。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始从头构建第一个AI原生的金融数据公司。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别人靠人工聚合海量数据，成本高、延迟大。他用AI来解决这个问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈：React + Next.js 做前端，后端用多LLM、Python、Cloudflare。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但Bradon很快意识到——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做数据产品（DaaS）比做软件产品（SaaS）难多了。时间长，复杂度高。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他没等"完美"才发布。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""永远不完美。你要永远追求持续改进。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他从丰田的"Kaizen"理念中获得灵感——持续改善，哪怕每次只改进一点点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "增长策略是什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "什么都试。管用的，三倍投入。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们主打产品驱动增长（PLG），自助服务，没花一分钱广告。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但同时，他们也在做B2B直销。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期有人说："你们不能同时做两边。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Braden部分同意，但他发现——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果产品对两类用户都一样，只是销售方式不同，那就没问题。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，数十万人信任Fiscal.ai，50多家企业把他们的数据集成到自己的产品里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "预计六个月内突破八位数ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Braden的建议简单粗暴——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just start。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""先找到几个需要你帮他们解决问题的客户。其他都不重要。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他相信直觉。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""早期CEO的核心能力，就是在信息不完整的情况下做决策。相信你的 gut feeling。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有，情绪管理。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""别太high，也别太low。说起来容易，做起来难。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Braden的故事印证了一个道理——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最好的创业机会，往往藏在你自己的痛点里。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他是个投资者，需要金融数据。市场上的产品要么太贵，要么太烂。所以他做了一个给自己用的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后发现，原来很多人跟他一样。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是创业的起点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是宏大的愿景，不是改变世界的梦想。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "解决一个你自己遇到的问题。然后发现，足够多的人也有这个问题。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "剩下的，交给时间。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en: Nuclear power engineer switched to financial AI earning seven figures. He said market either too expensive or too terrible empty in middle. Do you know the most ridiculous career change. From nuclear power plant to fintech. Braden Dennis did exactly that. He used to work in nuclear energy and hydropower engineering. Now he is founder of Fiscal.ai earning seven figures pushing towards eight. One. Braden has ideal. He wants to invent something new that benefits Earth. This ideal he has not given up yet. But he became obsessed with another thing. Investment. He started疯狂研究市场. Read all Buffett Munger shareholder letters watched all interviews and books he could find. The more he researched more he discovered strange phenomenon. Financial market has two extreme polarizations. One end is expensive professional data terminals like Bloomberg ridiculously expensive ordinary people cannot afford. Other end is free trading apps ugly interface full of advertisements not professional at all. Empty in middle. Nothing. Braden confused. Public company financial reports are all public. Why is aggregating this data providing clean experience so difficult. He found opportunity. Two. He started building first AI native financial data company from scratch. Others rely on manual aggregation of massive data high cost high latency. He uses AI to solve this problem. Tech stack React plus Next.
